```yaml
name: Release Binaries

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target:
          - x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          - x86_64-apple-darwin
          - aarch64-apple-darwin
          - x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v1
        with:
          deno-version: v1.x

      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          deno compile \
            --target=${{ matrix.target }} \
            --output=invidious-companion-${{ matrix.target }} \
            --allow-read \
            --allow-net \
            --allow-env \
            main.ts

      - name: Upload to Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: invidious-companion-${{ matrix.target }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
